module: Campaign loader: finds the /campaigns/*.json files whose header.type is "campaign", loads them (with mod info and preview image), validates and prepares a campaign, starts it (or resumes a save) and manages saves in /saves/campaigns/ (slotN.json files with header.type "campaignSave"). The campaign modules are campaign_campaigns, campaign_comics, campaign_rewards, campaign_dealer and campaign_photoSafari (M.campaignModules).
notes: Saving: saveCampaign launches the hook onSaveCampaign(callback); each module calls the callback with (global alias, data); the result is written as JSON with a header {version = 1, type = 'campaignSave', title}. Nothing is saved if meta.enableSaves is false.
A save matches a campaign by its title (meta.title).
resumeSavedCampaign calls onResumeCampaign on each saved module via _G (except campaign_campaigns, resumed last with campaign_campaigns.resumeCampaign).
Bug: M.onInit = onInit exports a variable not defined in this file (nil).
Bug: startByFolder calls campaign_campaigns.start, which is not exported by campaigns.lua (it exports startCampaign); the call fails. Use campaign_campaignsLoader.start instead.

Bug: processCampaignStartInternal tests "if campaign then stop() " with globals not defined in this file; only a validation failure (unreachable since validate always returns true) would make it return nil.
splitFieldByToken builds the pattern "([^"..token..".]+)": the dot is always excluded in addition to the given token.
start waits for the current level to end (scenetree.MissionGroup) before launching the campaign, via endActiveGameMode and triggerDelayedStartGenerator.

campaignModules.desc: Extension modules loaded for a campaign.

onInit.desc: Always nil: reference to a variable not defined in the file.

loadCampaign.desc: Reads a campaign's JSON and adds sourceFile, sourcePath, official, modID/modName/modTitle ("BeamNG" / "BeamNG.drive" values if it is not a mod) and previews (.jpg image from the campaign folder).

campaignfile.desc: Path of the campaign's JSON file.

getCampaignFilenames.desc: Lists the JSON files in /campaigns/ (1 level) whose header.type == 'campaign'. Returns {} if the folder does not exist.

getList.desc: Loads all the campaigns found with loadCampaign and returns them; cooperates with util_asyncBulkLoader if a bulk load is in progress.

getCampaignScenarios.desc: Returns the cached list scenariosInAllCampaigns (empty in this file: never filled here; generateCampaignScenariosList exists but is not called).

splitFieldByToken.desc: Splits a string by a token character (also excluding the dot) and returns the pieces.

start.desc: Starts a campaign chosen in the interface. If a level is loaded, waits for it to close; otherwise unloads the automatic extensions, loads those of the scenario, the quick race and the campaign, prepares the campaign, then resumes an existing save or calls campaign_campaigns.startCampaign.

startByFolder.desc: Finds the campaign whose sourcePath is path and starts it.

checkSaveExists.desc: Returns the save file name matching a campaign title, or nil.

savesEnabled.desc: If false, returns nil without searching anything.

saveCampaign.desc: Saves the campaign state (see notes) in /saves/campaigns/; reuses the existing file with the same title, otherwise takes the next "slotN.json".

campaign.desc: Processed campaign ({meta, state}); meta.enableSaves and meta.title are read.

resumeSavedCampaign.desc: Rereads a save file, calls onResumeCampaign of each module concerned again, then campaign_campaigns.resumeCampaign.
